turns.text: Trader, this is the militia. Cut engines for a contraband check.
Of course, officer, I'm clean, just hauling grain to New Detroit.
Our scanners say otherwise. Those crates read as Brilliance.
That's-- that's a sensor glitch, I swear on the guild!
Power down. You're impounded, smuggler.
No, please, I'll lose everything! Can't we work something out?
Bribery now? That's another charge. Prepare to be boarded.
Back off, hunter. This merchant's cargo is mine.
I'm not here for the cargo. I'm here for you.
You've got a contract on me? Who's paying?
Does it matter? Nothing personal. It's just good business.
Then come and collect, you cold-blooded snake!
Gladly. One more for the resume.
Pirate vessel, this is Confed patrol. You're under arrest.
Arrest? Out here? You Confed boys are a long way from home.
We've accessed your file. Murder, smuggling, piracy. It ends now.
It ends when I say it ends, badge.
Have it your way. All units, weapons free.
Heathen! Your hold is full of the devil's machines!
It's mining equipment, you lunatic! Leave me be!
Technology is the rot of mankind. Repent, or burn!
Somebody, anybody, there's a retro on my tail!
No one hears you out here. Only God. And He approves.
Halt, apeling. Your cargo smells of fear.
I'm just passing through. I don't want a fight.
Wise. Perhaps I let you live, to tell the others of me.
...Generous of you.
Do not mistake boredom for mercy. Fly, before I change my mind.
Confed wing, this is system militia. We've got this one.
Negative, militia. That's a Confederation fugitive.
He's in our space, breaking our laws. He's ours.
Stand down. You're outgunned and out-ranked.
...Acknowledged. He's all yours, flyboy. Don't lose him.
There you are. You're worth a lot of credits, Captain.
Whoever hired you, I can pay double. Name it.
Tempting. But a hunter who breaks contract never works again.
Then you leave me no choice.
None of us ever had one, friend. Now hold still.
Confederation ship. We have unfinished business, your kind and mine.
The war's over, cat. Your empire lost.
Empires fall. Hatred endures. Defend yourself.
All wings, Kilrathi raider, weapons hot!
Friendly hull, good to see one out here. Slow run today?
Brutal. Pirates thick as flies past the jump point.
Tell me about it. Lost a cousin on the Palan route last week.
Stay sharp, friend. Fair winds and full holds.
Militia patrol, eh? Bit far from your little checkpoint.
Far enough to put you down with no witnesses, scum.
Big talk for a rent-a-cop. Let's see if your aim matches.
Gladly. Militia to base, engaging a hostile.
Primitive vessel. You carry a fragment of the old ones.
The... what? I don't understand you.
You would not. Surrender the relic, or be unmade.
That's not an answer I can live with.
Then you have chosen. We are sorry. We are thorough.
